show.description: Kasak is an emotional family drama filled with love, ambition, and hidden motives. Riya’s life takes a dramatic turn when two powerful suitors enter her world—one a wealthy charmer, the other connected to India’s biggest AI empire. As relationships deepen, secrets, ego clashes, and family conflicts unravel, leading to unexpected twists that test love, trust, and destiny. Watch now.
